Unreal Developer - Internship — Xogar Games, Bengaluru
We are looking for a talented and passionate Unreal Developer Intern with a solid understanding of C++ programming to join our development team, contributing to the creation and integration of game mechanics, asset pipelines, and immersive experiences for our AAA title.
Key Responsibilities:
- Assist in the integration of gameplay features and mechanics in Unreal Engine 5 using both Blueprints and C++.
- Support the implementation and optimization of game assets, visual effects, and environmental interactions.
- Collaborate with the design and art teams to ensure smooth implementation of assets and systems.
- Write clean, efficient, and well-documented C++ code for gameplay systems and tools.
- Troubleshoot and debug technical issues related to game development.
- Work on enhancing the performance and quality of game features.
- Participate in team meetings, code reviews, and contribute ideas for game improvements.
Required Skills & Tools:
- Game Engine: Unreal Engine 5 (Essential)
- Programming Languages: C++ (Good foundational knowledge required)
- Version Control Systems: Plastic SCM / Git / Perforce
- 3D Software (Basic understanding): Autodesk Maya / Blender / 3ds Max (for asset handling)
- Texturing (Basic understanding): Substance Painter / Substance Designer
- Visual Scripting: Familiarity with Unreal Blueprints
- Understanding of game development pipeline and real-time rendering.
- Good problem-solving and debugging skills.
Good to Have:
- Understanding of multiplayer game development.
- Basic knowledge of shaders and materials in Unreal Engine.
- Passion for game design and player experience.
- Familiarity with performance optimization techniques.
Eligibility Criteria:
- Pursuing or recently completed a degree/diploma in Computer Science, Game Development, or a related field.
- Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
